query: DO $$ DECLARE v_template_id UUID; BEGIN SELECT id INTO v_template_id FROM public.inspection_templates WHERE code = 'government-hospital-accreditation'; IF v_template_id IS NOT NULL THEN DELETE FROM public.inspection_template_items WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND section_code = 'STAFFING'; DELETE FROM public.inspection_template_sections WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND section_code = 'STAFFING'; END IF; END $$;
